EC1: 1. Included in another clinical study that could confound the results of this study such as studies involving intra-cardiac device
EC2: 2. Contraindication to a maximum single dose of 310 µg Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate (DSP)
EC3: 3. Tricuspid valvular disease [OR] or tricuspid replacement heart valve (mechanical [OR] or tissue) only for subject with DR pacemaker
EC4: 4. Active myocarditis, pocket [OR] and/or lead infection
EC5: 5. Age less than 18 years old or under guardianship or kept in detention
EC7: 7. Known pregnancy, women breastfeeding [OR] or in childbearing age [NOT] without an adequate contraceptive method
EC8: 8. Be unavailable for the scheduled follow-up associated with this clinical study or refusal to cooperate
